messages.subject: ctmm 0.5.2 overlap, uere changes
parts:
1) Previously, in versions 0.5.1 and below, the AKDE overlaps could either be calculated via
overlap(data_list,ctmm_list)
or
overlap(ud_list,ctmm_list)
with UDs were calculated on the same grid. As there is no real case where users want the overlaps and not the UDs, and as the fitted model is specific to the UD, AKDE overlap usage in 0.5.2 has been simplified to just
overlap(ud_list)
with no ctmm_list argument. The model fit object is now stored in a slot of the UD object.

2) Previously, in versions 0.5.1 and below, UERE estimates were calculated from calibration data via
UERE <- uere(calibration_data)
which is confusing as UERE values were assigned via
uere(data_to_calibrate) <- UERE
Starting in ctmm 0.5.2, uere() only reports how the data has been calibrated and now uere.fit() is used to estimate UERE values. So the same calibration process looks like
UERE <- uere.fit(calibration_data)
uere(data_to_calibrate) <- UERE
See, also, https://ctmm-initiative.github.io/ctmm/reference/uere.html

Best,
Chris
